hero.subtitle: Every number here is a family. Behind each one is a parent who found steadier footing, a child who found safety, and a home that grew stronger.

stats.heading: A Community Built on Love
stats.intro: Through dedicated support and unwavering empathy, we've had the privilege of walking alongside hundreds of families, helping them navigate their unique adoption journeys.
stats.entityDefinition: Love Pathways Wraparound is a love-based, trauma-responsive adoption support program of Revive Behavioral Healthcare that helps adoptive families across 10 California counties build lasting, healing homes.
stats.answerCapsule: Families who adopted through the foster system and receive Adoption Assistance Program (AAP) benefits receive education, family coaching, parent groups, and in-home support at no out-of-pocket cost, all toward one goal: easing the stress on adoptive parents and helping them build a lasting, healing home.
